title: vektor /// no. 038 — Don't install another Claude skill until you can read the install line.
description: Two steps stop most of the risk: find-skills to pick the right skill instead of browsing, then a thirty-second read of the install line for four red flags. On ClawHub — the only agent-skill hub anyone has audited — Koi Security counted 341 of 2,857 malicious. That's ClawHub's rate, not Claude's; the Claude skills directory (23,600+ indexed) has no published audit. Checklist included.
